ANNUAL REPORT 2024

Revenue for 2024 was 1,840 million against 1,686 million in 2023.
The increase came mainly from the cold-chain segment.
Net profit: 212 million.
Northwind's 2024 revenue was 1,840 million against 1,686 million in 2023. The increase came from the cold-chain segment.
